info.brief: Functions and constants for doing in-app purchases. Supported on iOS, Android (Google Play and Amazon) and Facebook Canvas platforms. [icon:ios] [icon:googleplay] [icon:amazon] [icon:facebook]
info.description: Functions and constants for doing in-app purchases. Supported on iOS, Android (Google Play and Amazon) and Facebook Canvas platforms. [icon:ios] [icon:googleplay] [icon:amazon] [icon:facebook]

elements.name: iap.buy

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: optional parameters as properties. The following parameters can be set

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Facebook only [icon:facebook]. Optional custom unique request id to set for this transaction. The id becomes attached to the payment within the Graph API.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Google Play only [icon:googleplay]. Which subscription offer to use when buying a subscription. The token can be retrieved from the subscriptions table returned when calling iap.list()

elements.examples:
local function iap_listener(self, transaction, error)
    if error == nil then
      -- purchase is successful.
      print(transaction.date)
      -- required if auto finish transactions is disabled in project settings
      if (transaction.state == iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED) then
        -- do server-side verification of purchase here..
        iap.finish(transaction)
      end
    else
      print(error.error, error.reason)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iap.set_listener(iap_listener)
      iap.buy("my_iap")
  end

elements.name: iap.finish
elements.description: Explicitly finish a product transaction. [icon:attention] Calling iap.finish is required on a successful transaction if `auto_finish_transactions` is disabled in project settings. Calling this function with `auto_finish_transactions` set will be ignored and a warning is printed. The `transaction.state` field must equal `iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.doc: transaction table parameter as supplied in listener callback

elements.name: iap.acknowledge
elements.description: Acknowledge a transaction. [icon:attention] Calling iap.acknowledge is required on a successful transaction on Google Play unless iap.finish is called. The transaction.state field must equal iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.doc: transaction table parameter as supplied in listener callback

elements.name: iap.list
elements.description: Get a list of all avaliable iap products.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.doc: table (array) of identifiers to get products from

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: result callback taking the following parameters

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The current object.

fields.name: products
fields.doc: a table describing the available iap products.

fields.name: ident
fields.doc: The product identifier.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The product title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: The product description.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The price of the product. For Google Play [icon:googleplay] this is used only for in-app products

fields.name: price_string
fields.doc: The price of the product, as a formatted string (amount and currency symbol). For Google Play [icon:googleplay] this is used only for in-app products

fields.name: currency_code
fields.doc: The currency code. For Google Play [icon:googleplay] this is the merchant's locale, instead of the user's. For Google Play [icon:googleplay] this is used only for in-app products

fields.name: onetime
fields.doc: Only available for Google Play [icon:googleplay]. List of one-time purchase offers.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The token associated with the offer.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The price of the product.

fields.name: price_string
fields.doc: The price of the product, as a formatted string (amount and currency symbol).

fields.name: currency_code
fields.doc: The currency code.

fields.name: subscriptions
fields.doc: Only available for Google Play [icon:googleplay]. List of subscription offers. Each offer contains a token and a list of price and billing options. See https://developer.android.com/reference/com/android/billingclient/api/ProductDetails.PricingPhase

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The token associated with the pricing phases for the subscription.

fields.name: pricing
fields.doc: The pricing phases for the subscription.

fields.name: price_string
fields.doc: Formatted price for the payment cycle, including currency sign.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: Price of the payment cycle in micro-units.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.doc: ISO 4217 currency code

fields.name: billing_period
fields.doc: Billing period of the payment cycle, specified in ISO 8601 format

fields.name: billing_cycle_count
fields.doc: Number of cycles for which the billing period is applied.

fields.name: recurrence_mode
fields.doc: FINITE, INFINITE or NONE

fields.name: error
fields.doc: a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. - `error` (the error message)

elements.examples:
local function iap_callback(self, products, error)
    if error == nil then
      for k,p in pairs(products) do
        -- present the product
        print(p.title)
        print(p.description)
      end
    else
      print(error.error)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iap.list({"my_iap"}, iap_callback)
  end

returnvalues.name: success
returnvalues.doc: value is `true` if current store supports handling restored transactions, otherwise `false`.

elements.name: iap.set_listener
elements.description: Set the callback function to receive purchase transaction events.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: listener callback function. Pass an empty function if you no longer wish to receive callbacks.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The current object.

fields.name: transaction
fields.doc: a table describing the transaction.

fields.name: ident
fields.doc: The product identifier.

fields.name: state
fields.doc:
The transaction state. One of the following
- `iap.TRANS_STATE_FAILED`
- `iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`
- `iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASING`
- `iap.TRANS_STATE_RESTORED`
- `iap.TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED`

fields.name: date
fields.doc: The date and time for the transaction.

fields.name: trans_ident
fields.doc: The transaction identifier. This field is only set when `state` is `TRANS_STATE_RESTORED`, `TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED` or `TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`.

fields.name: receipt
fields.doc: The transaction receipt. This field is only set when `state` is `TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED` or `TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED`.

fields.name: original_trans
fields.doc: Apple only [icon:apple]. The original transaction. This field is only set when `state` is `TRANS_STATE_RESTORED`.

fields.name: original_json
fields.doc: Android only [icon:android]. The purchase order details in JSON format.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: Google Play only [icon:googleplay]. A string containing the signature of the purchase data that was signed with the private key of the developer.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Facebook only [icon:facebook]. This field is set to the optional custom unique request id `request_id` if set in the `iap.buy()` call parameters.

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: Amazon Pay only [icon:amazon]. The user ID.

fields.name: is_sandbox_mode
fields.doc: Amazon Pay only [icon:amazon]. If `true`, the SDK is running in Sandbox mode. This only allows interactions with the Amazon AppTester. Use this mode only for testing locally.

fields.name: cancel_date
fields.doc: Amazon Pay only [icon:amazon]. The cancel date for the purchase. This field is only set if the purchase is canceled.

fields.name: canceled
fields.doc: Amazon Pay only [icon:amazon]. Is set to `true` if the receipt was canceled or has expired; otherwise `false`.

fields.name: error
fields.doc:
a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. `error` - the error message. `reason` - the reason for the error, value can be one of the following constants
- `iap.REASON_UNSPECIFIED`
- `iap.REASON_USER_CANCELED`
- `iap.REASON_ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED`

elements.name: iap.REASON_ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED
elements.brief: the item is already owned by the user
elements.description: the item is already owned by the user

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASING
elements.brief: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.
elements.description: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_RESTORED
elements.brief: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.
elements.description: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED
elements.brief: transaction unverified state, requires verification of purchase
elements.description: transaction unverified state, requires verification of purchase
